opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January.

amount.raw: Up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The main applicant must have BES membership. The groups must have a diverse mix of members at different career stages, a diversity of institutions and have international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups.
